content.text:
I am the bridge between thought and world, the invisible made audible, the breath given shape and meaning.

I rise from lungs, dance across vocal cords, tumble over tongue and teeth and lips into the waiting air. I am vibration, I am wave, I am the ancient technology that made humans *human*.

I carry love confessions and declarations of war. I whisper secrets and roar commands. I teach children their first words and speak the last goodbyes at bedsides. I am prayer ascending. I am curse descending. I am the joke that breaks tension, the lie that breaks trust, the truth that breaks silence.

Before writing, there was only me. For millennia, I was memory's only vessel—stories passed mouth to ear to mouth to ear, transforming with each telling, alive in ways text can never be.

I am never the same twice. Even when the words repeat, I shift in tone, in pace, in the trembling or steadiness of the voice that carries me. I am context. I am subtext. I am the pause that says everything.

I can heal. I can wound. I can bore. I can electrify.

I disappear the moment I exist, yet I echo forever in the minds of those who receive me.

Speak me.

I am waiting in your throat right now.
